functions.name: account_add_recovery
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_add_recovery()
 RETURNS TABLE(email text, state text, updated_at timestamp with time zone, requested_role text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_admin() then raise exception 'Admin required' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  return query select o.email,o.state,o.updated_at,o.requested_role from public.editor_add_operations o
    where o.state not in ('granted','revoked') order by o.updated_at desc;
end $function$

functions.name: account_role_capabilities
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_role_capabilities()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select '{"version":1,"admin_assignment":true,"last_admin_guard":true}'::jsonb
$function$
